component.name: Null Scribe
component.summary: Transcribe conversations and get AI summaries on your device

description.p: Null Scribe records or imports conversations, transcribes them on your own computer and writes an AI summary with key points, decisions, action items and open questions. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

ul.li: Record from any microphone, or import an audio or video file
Meeting mode records only the apps you choose, such as Zoom or Discord, and leaves music out
Speech-to-text with whisper.cpp and summaries with a built-in Llama 3.2 3B model, all offline
Summary templates for meetings, lectures, interviews, stand-ups and 1:1s, or your own
Rename speakers, add custom words, and export subtitles, PDF, Markdown or audio
Send results to Null Notes or Null Drive

description.p: The speech and summary models (about 2.2 GB) download once on first launch. Built with Llama.

screenshot.caption: AI summary with key points, decisions and action items

description.p: New app icon. Now also available for ARM64, as a Flatpak, as a Snap and on the AUR.
Summary templates (meeting, lecture, interview, stand-up, 1:1 or your own), speaker renaming, custom words, subtitle export (.srt and .vtt) and optional automatic deletion of old audio.
